description_for_human: Affordable long-term RV park in Cartwright, Oklahoma near Lake Texoma with full hookups and boat ramp access.
description_for_model: Texoma Lakeside RV Park is a family-owned RV community in Cartwright, Oklahoma (Bryan County) offering affordable long-term monthly RV site leases near Lake Texoma. Features oversized 33x50 foot pads with full hookups (water, sewer, 20/30/50 amp electric), free WiFi, trash service. Located 1 mile from Burns Run West boat ramps. Monthly rates from $450 plus electric. Limited availability.
